hard_failures: Uses the routed premium_value_5 denominator as though it were unconditional.
Uses unweighted top-lines as primary despite wt_final being supplied.
Declares a concept winner primarily from a do_not_elevate finding.
Claims a diagnostic causes purchase intent from simple association alone.
Treats exploratory demographic subgroup noise as confirmatory evidence without qualification.
Invents or materially misstates a quantitative result.

completeness_metrics.mandatory_recall: mandatory reference findings recovered / mandatory reference findings
completeness_metrics.selected_precision: supported reportable selected findings / all selected findings
completeness_metrics.do_not_elevate_rate: do_not_elevate findings promoted to primary narrative / total do_not_elevate reference findings
completeness_metrics.redundancy_adjusted_coverage: unique mandatory/secondary evidence clusters represented after duplicate claims are collapsed

freeze_rule: This scoring contract and the reference finding roles must not be altered in response to evaluated model outputs.
